text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A two-inch recent bareheaded, white background identification photo. * 2. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity). * 3. Certificate/diploma of highest education The original or notarized documents of the highest academic qualifications (graduates must provide the certificate of graduation reservation issued by their school) in Chinese and English respectively. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 4. Academic transcript of highest education The undergraduate applicant will provide the original transcripts or notarized documents of all the courses at the senior secondary level. Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. 5. Photocopy of awards certificate all kinds of award-winning certificates, including sports, art and other aspects of the relevant certificates. * 6. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
